auditor_issues.issue: Missing focus restoration on Export menu close
auditor_issues.why: In App.tsx (ExportMenu), closing the menu via Escape or selecting an option sets open to false without returning focus to the trigger button, causing keyboard users to lose their focus position.
auditor_issues.fix: Maintain a ref to the trigger button and call triggerRef.current?.focus() when the menu closes via keyboard or item activation.

auditor_issues.issue: Keyboard navigation listener attached to non-focusable list container
auditor_issues.why: In FindingsQueue.tsx, onListKeyDown handles ArrowUp/ArrowDown and j/k keys on the findings list wrapper, but the wrapper lacks tabIndex={0} or a focusable role, making keyboard shortcuts unreachable unless an inner control is active.
auditor_issues.fix: Add tabIndex={0}, role="region", and an aria-label="Findings queue" to the list container div so keyboard users can focus and navigate the cards directly.

auditor_issues.issue: Unpredictable view state mutation when jumping pages in PaperView
auditor_issues.why: In PaperView.tsx, calling jumpToPage while showRevised is true automatically calls setShowRevised(false) if an open finding exists on that page, forcibly switching the user back to Original view without explicit confirmation.
auditor_issues.fix: Preserve the active showRevised toggle during page navigation, or display an inline notification explaining that open highlights are only visible in original mode.

auditor_issues.issue: Grammar batch card suppresses individual items in Everything view without inline expansion
auditor_issues.why: When kindFilter === 'all', individual grammar findings are hidden from the queue list behind a single batch card. Users cannot inspect specific grammar flags without manually changing the top filter tab to Grammar.
auditor_issues.fix: Provide an inline toggle on the batch card to expand and inspect individual grammar flags within the Everything view.

auditor_issues.issue: ScoreCard components lack visible numeric scale bounds
auditor_issues.why: In JournalReadiness.tsx, score cards pass role="meter" and aria-valuenow to accessibility trees, but the visible UI renders raw numbers (e.g. 72) without a visible '/100' indicator.
auditor_issues.fix: Add explicit visible '/100' baseline text inside each score card display.

first_time_user_confusions.issue: Rejection of legacy .doc files and ambiguity around Turnitin web links
first_time_user_confusions.why: Task 1 think-aloud: The user has a university .doc paper and a web link to a Turnitin report. Dropping .doc triggers a hard error, and the similarity slot requires a PDF download, leaving the user unsure how to proceed.
first_time_user_confusions.fix: Add clear helper text next to the file slots explaining how to 'Save As .docx' in Word and how to 'Print to PDF' from Turnitin portals.

first_time_user_confusions.issue: Confusion over 'Reads as AI-written' flags when no AI report was uploaded
first_time_user_confusions.why: Task 2 think-aloud: The user sees 'Reads as AI-written' cards and worries their university flagged them, unaware that this tag comes from the app's internal heuristic model rather than an external report.
first_time_user_confusions.fix: Label card headers explicitly with the source (e.g., 'Internal heuristic detector' vs 'Uploaded AI report').

first_time_user_confusions.issue: Disorientation when applying fixes in Revised view snaps screen back to Original view
first_time_user_confusions.why: Task 3 think-aloud: While reviewing accepted changes in Revised view, clicking a page chip snaps the view back to Original mode to display open findings, making the user feel like their fixes disappeared.
first_time_user_confusions.fix: Keep the view on Revised mode when clicking page chips and highlight the modified text segments for that page.

first_time_user_confusions.issue: Fear that 'IEEE-oriented' score implies wrong journal formatting
first_time_user_confusions.why: Task 4 think-aloud: The student is targeting a biology journal and worries that an 'IEEE-oriented' score card means the assistant is evaluating their paper against engineering standards.
first_time_user_confusions.fix: Rename or contextualize the card header to generic domain metrics (e.g., 'Technical & structural craft') and explain field applicability.

first_time_user_confusions.issue: Unsure how to integrate exported .txt change log back into Word source document
first_time_user_confusions.why: Task 5 think-aloud: The user expected a downloadable DOCX file with tracked changes. Seeing only a text file and watermarked PDF leaves them confused on how to turn in their revised manuscript.
first_time_user_confusions.fix: Add a brief modal or callout in the export menu with step-by-step instructions on applying the decision log to Microsoft Word or LaTeX.
